summary: @servicetitan/anvil2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it on the sibling file `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-CJS bundle with a shuffled string/opcode array and a rotating decoder (a `push/shift` array rotator) with hex-mangled identifiers — an obfuscated payload whose contents are not observable to Node-based install scanners because execution is handed off to a freshly downloaded second runtime. Neither `math_init.js` nor `setup.mjs` is enumerated in the `package.json` `files` manifest (which lists only `dist`, `token`, `CHANGELOG.md`), yet both are shipped at the tarball root and reached by the lifecycle hook. The package's advertised purpose is a React UI component library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time and execute an obfuscated sibling script under it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
